note: From the Fayette County composite sample ballot, which marks incumbents with (I). No countywide county office is on this ballot. Not shown because they depend on your district: County Commission Districts 3 and 4, County Board of Education Districts 2 and 4, and state legislative and U.S. House districts. The three statewide constitutional amendments are statewide questions. Check your official sample ballot (Georgia My Voter Page).

measures.title: Fayette County homestead ad valorem exemption (floating)
measures.summary: Would provide a homestead exemption from Fayette County property taxes for county purposes in a floating amount, based on how much the property taxes collected in a given year exceed the property taxes collected in tax year 2025.
measures.yesMeans: Homesteads would get a floating exemption from county property taxes tied to growth above 2025 tax levels.
measures.noMeans: The Act is not approved and this county homestead exemption does not take effect.

measures.title: Fayette County School District homestead ad valorem tax exemption (floating)
measures.summary: Would provide a homestead exemption from Fayette County School District property taxes for educational purposes in a floating amount, based on how much the property taxes collected in a given year exceed the property taxes collected in tax year 2025.
measures.yesMeans: Homesteads would get a floating exemption from school property taxes tied to growth above 2025 tax levels.
measures.noMeans: The Act is not approved and this school homestead exemption does not take effect.

measures.title: City of Fayetteville FLOST homestead exemption (floating)
measures.summary: Would provide a homestead exemption from City of Fayetteville property taxes for municipal purposes in a floating amount, based on how much the property taxes collected in a given year exceed the property taxes collected in tax year 2025.
measures.yesMeans: Homesteads in the City of Fayetteville would get a floating exemption from city property taxes tied to growth above 2025 tax levels.
measures.noMeans: The Act is not approved and this city homestead exemption does not take effect.
